```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(df, items=None, locations=None):
    if not isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame):
        raise ValueError("df must be a pandas DataFrame")

    if "Item" not in df.columns or "Location" not in df.columns:
        raise ValueError("df must contain 'Item' and 'Location' columns")

    if items is None:
        items = pd.Index(df["Item"].dropna()).unique().tolist()
    else:
        items = list(items)

    if locations is None:
        locations = pd.Index(df["Location"].dropna()).unique().tolist()
    else:
        locations = list(locations)

    filtered = df.loc[df["Item"].isin(items) & df["Location"].isin(locations), ["Item", "Location"]]

    counts = (
        filtered.groupby(["Location", "Item"], sort=False)
        .size()
        .unstack(fill_value=0)
        .reindex(index=locations, columns=items, fill_value=0)
    )

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()

    if counts.shape[0] > 0 and counts.shape[1] > 0:
        counts.plot(kind="bar", ax=ax)
        ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45)
    else:
        ax.set_xticks([])
        ax.set_yticks([])

    ax.set_title("Distribution of Items Across Locations")
    ax.set_xlabel("Location")
    ax.set_ylabel("Count")

    if items:
        ax.legend(title="Item")

    plt.tight_layout()
    return ax
```
